SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS acquisition_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS new_users,
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END))::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue_2024
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS ordered_at
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled' 
    AND u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, ordered_at, 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ordered_at) AS order_num,
    LAG(ordered_at) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ordered_at) AS prev_at
  FROM orders
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ordered_at - prev_at) / 86400) AS median_days
FROM ranked_orders
WHERE order_num = 2

WITH user_months AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at)::date AS acquisition_month,
    u.id AS user_id,
    u.created_at
  FROM public.users u
  WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
users_with_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    um.acquisition_month,
    um.user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN oi.order_id IS NOT NULL AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled' AND oi.created_at < um.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS placed_order
  FROM user_months um
  LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = um.user_id AND oi.created_at < um.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days' AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY um.acquisition_month, um.user_id
)
SELECT 
  TO_CHAR(acquisition_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS acquisition_month,
  COUNT(*) AS total_users,
  SUM(placed_order) AS users_with_orders,
  ROUND((SUM(placed_order)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 4) AS share
FROM users_with_orders
GROUP BY acquisition_month
ORDER BY share DESC

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS ordered_at
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled' 
    AND u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, ordered_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ordered_at) AS order_rank
  FROM orders
),
second_to_third AS (
  SELECT user_id, 
         MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 2 THEN ordered_at END) AS second_order_at,
         MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 3 THEN ordered_at END) AS third_order_at
  FROM ranked_orders
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 3 THEN ordered_at END) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM third_order_at - second_order_at) / 86400) AS median_days
FROM second_to_third

WITH per_user AS (SELECT oi.user_id, SUM(oi.sale_price) AS gross_spend FROM public.order_items oi WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled' AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY oi.user_id) SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gross_spend) AS percentile_90 FROM per_user

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.user_id, 
    oi.order_id, 
    MIN(oi.created_at) AS ordered_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.user_id ORDER BY MIN(oi.created_at)) AS order_rank
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled' 
    AND u.traffic_source = 'Organic'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
    AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
first_two_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_rank,
    ordered_at
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_rank IN (1, 2)
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 1 THEN ordered_at END) AS first_order_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 2 THEN ordered_at END) AS second_order_at
  FROM first_two_orders
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order_at - first_order_at)) / 86400) AS median_days
FROM gaps
WHERE second_order_at IS NOT NULL

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS ordered_at, SUM(oi.sale_price) AS order_value
  FROM public.order_items oi
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled' AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id, ordered_at, order_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ordered_at) AS order_rank
  FROM orders
),
first_orders AS (
  SELECT order_value
  FROM ranked_orders
  WHERE order_rank = 1
),
repeat_orders AS (
  SELECT order_value
  FROM ranked_orders
  WHERE order_rank > 1
),
medians AS (
  SELECT 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) AS first_median
  FROM first_orders
)
SELECT 
  first_median - (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FROM repeat_orders) AS difference
FROM medians

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS ordered_at
  FROM public.order_items oi
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled' AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
first_and_second AS (
  SELECT user_id, ordered_at,
    LAG(ordered_at) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ordered_at) AS prev_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ordered_at) AS order_rank
  FROM orders
),
users_with_2_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM first_and_second
  WHERE order_rank = 2
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT user_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ordered_at - prev_at) / 86400 AS days_gap
  FROM first_and_second
  WHERE prev_at IS NOT NULL AND order_rank = 2
    AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users_with_2_orders)
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_gap) AS percentile_95_days
FROM gaps

),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, ordered_at,

  FROM orders
),
first_second AS (
  SELECT user_id, ordered_at
  FROM ranked_orders
  WHERE order_rank <= 2
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT user_id, ordered_at,

  FROM first_second
)

FROM gaps

  (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FROM repeat_orders) AS repeat_median,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) - 
  (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FROM repeat_orders) AS difference
FROM first_orders

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS ordered_at
  FROM public.order_items oi
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled' AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id, ordered_at,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ordered_at) AS order_rank
  FROM orders
),
user_order_counts AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM ranked_orders
  GROUP BY user_id
),
first_two_orders AS (
  SELECT ro.user_id, ro.order_id, ro.ordered_at, ro.order_rank
  FROM ranked_orders ro
  JOIN user_order_counts uoc ON uoc.user_id = ro.user_id
  WHERE uoc.order_count >= 2 AND ro.order_rank <= 2
),
days_between AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_rank, ordered_at,
         LAG(ordered_at) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_rank) AS prev_at
  FROM first_two_orders
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ordered_at - prev_at) / 86400) AS percentile_95_days
FROM days_between
WHERE prev_at IS NOT NULL

WITH orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS ordered_at
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled' 
    AND u.traffic_source = 'Search'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
    AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, ordered_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ordered_at) AS order_rank
  FROM orders
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    ordered_at,
    LAG(ordered_at) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ordered_at) AS prev_at
  FROM ranked_orders
  WHERE order_rank <= 2
)
SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ordered_at - prev_at) / 86400))::numeric, 2) AS median_days
FROM gaps
WHERE prev_at IS NOT NULL
